day_local: Talaadada Usbuuca Soddonka ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Barakaysan yahay qof kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada.
homily:
Maanta, waxaan doonayaa inaan idin weydiiyo inaad maskaxda ku haysataan hal shay oo aad u yar, oo laga yaabo inay dadka kale u muuqato mid aan qiimo lahayn: waa xabbad khamiir ah oo lagu dhex tuuray baaquli bur ah. Waa shay aan la arki karin marka la isku qaso, laakiin saamayntiisu waa mid wax beddelaysa. Waa sawirka Ciise uu maanta Injiilka inoogu sharraxayo Boqortooyada Ilaah. Waxay ka bilaabataa wax yar, wax aan muuqan, laakiin si tartiib ah, iyadoo aan la dareemin, ayay u koraysaa ilaa ay wax walba beddesho.

Bal ka fikir xabbaddaas khamiirka ah. Waxay u baahan tahay inay dhex gasho burka. Waa inay qayb ka noqotaa cajiinka si ay u shaqayso. Sidaas oo kale ayay nolosheennu u shaqaysaa. Mararka qaarkood, waxaan dareemnaa in nolosheennu ay tahay mid go'an, ama in dhibaatada ina haysataa ay tahay mid aad u weyn oo aan la qaadi karin. Waxaan eegnaa qolka Ben, ama aan eegnaa xusuusta xagaagii hore, waxaana dareemaynaa in dunidu ay istaagtay. Laakiin Boqortooyada Ilaah waxay leedahay qaab kale. Waxay ku dhex jirtaa xanuunka, waxay ku dhex jirtaa aamusnaanta, waxayna si tartiib ah u shaqaysaa sidii khamiirka oo kale.

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil noloshaas khamiirka ah noo ahaa. Ma ahan oo kaliya maskaxdiisii fiiqan ee xisaabta iyo tiknoolajiyadda, ama sida uu u jeclaa 'con chim airlines' oo uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray, laakiin wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu uu ahaa mid si joogto ah u koraya. Xusuusnow markuu u soo bandhigay inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu u caawiyo qof xanuunsan waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Taasi waa khamiirka Boqortooyada. Waa jacayl aan la arki karin, laakiin beddelaya qofka bixinaya iyo qofka helaya labadaba.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo aad u culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Boqortooyada Ilaah ay tahay mid xoog badan oo aan la joojin karin. Waxay leedahay awood ay wax walba ku khamiiriso. Xanuunkiinna, ilmadinna, iyo xusuusta Ben, dhammaantood waxay qayb ka yihiin shaqada Ilaah ee weyn. Ha ka cabsanin inaad xanuunkaaga u dhiibto Ilaah. Ha ka cabsanin inaad ooyso. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel aan xanuun lahayn, meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya sida uu mar walba ahaan jiray.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida khamiirka oo kale, jacaylka uu Ben kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaanan rabaa inaan kugu qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Eucharist-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruuxa naftayda. Waxaan isku duubayaa sida inaad horey u joogtay, waxaana gebi ahaanba ku xirayaa naftayda adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga hormaray, inay nabad iyo iftiin ku helaan gacmaha Aabbaha, annaguna aan xasuusannaa jacaylka ay noo reebeen.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan Alan, Thao, iyo Ryan, inay helaan raaxada Ilaah iyo rajo xooggan oo ka caawisa inay maalin kasta horay u socdaan.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Midba midka kale u hoggaansama cabsida Masiixa. Haweenku nimankooda ha u hoggaansamaan sida ay Rabbiga u hoggaansamaan. Waayo, ninku waa madaxa naagtiisa, sida Masiixuna u yahay madaxa kiniisadda, isagoo ah badbaadiyaha jidhka. Sida kiniisaddu Masiixa u hoggaansanto, waa inay haweenkuna nimankooda u hoggaansamaan wax walba. Nimankow, xaasaskiinna jeclaada, sida Masiixu kiniisadda u jeclaaday oo uu naftiisa u bixiyay si uu u quduus ka dhigo, isagoo ku nadiifiyay maydhista biyaha iyo ereyga, si uu naftiisa ugu soo bandhigo kiniisad qurux badan, oo aan lahayn bar ama laalaab ama wax kale, si ay u noqoto mid quduus ah oo aan eed lahayn. Sidaas oo kale, nimanku waa inay xaasaskooda u jeclaadaan sida jidhkooda. Kii xaaskiisa jecel, naftiisuu jecel yahay. Waayo, ninna weligii ma nicin jidhkiisa, laakiin wuu quudiyaa oo daryeelaa, sida Masiixu u daryeelo kiniisadda, maxaa yeelay, aynu nahay xubno jidhkiisa ka mid ah. Sidaas darteed, nin baa ka tagi doona aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, wuxuuna la midobi doonaa xaaskiisa, labaduna waxay noqon doonaan jidh keliya. Tani waa qarsoodi weyn, laakiin waxaan uga hadlayaa Masiixa iyo kiniisadda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, mid kasta oo idinka mid ah ha u jeclaado xaaskiisa sida naftiisa, naagtiina ha u maamuusto ninkeeda.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Barakaysan yahay qof kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada. Barakaysan yahay qof kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada, oo ku socda jidadkiisa! Waayo, waxaad cuni doontaa midhaha gacmahaaga; barakaysan ayaad ahaan doontaa, waana lagu guulaysan doonaa. R. Barakaysan yahay qof kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada. Xaaskaagu waxay noqon doontaa sida canab midho badan oo ku yaal guryahaaga; carruurtaaduna sida geedaha saytuunka ah oo ku wareegsan miiskaaga. R. Barakaysan yahay qof kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada. Bal eeg, sidaas ayaa loo barakeeyaa ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada. Rabbigu ha kaa barakeeyo Siyoon: ha aragto barwaaqada Yeruusaalem maalmaha noloshaada oo dhan. R. Barakaysan yahay qof kasta oo Rabbiga ka cabsada.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu yidhi, 'Maxay Boqortooyada Ilaah u eg tahay? Maxaan u barbardhigaa? Waxay u eg tahay abuur khardal ah oo nin beertiisa ku beeray. Markuu koray, wuxuu noqday geed weyn, shimbiraha cirka ayaana laamihiisa degay.' Haddana wuxuu yidhi, 'Maxaan u barbardhigaa Boqortooyada Ilaah? Waxay u eg tahay khamiir naag qaadatay oo ku dhex dartay saddex qiyaasood oo bur ah ilaa uu cajiinkii oo dhan khamiiray.'

day: Tuesday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
